data.name: Adna
data.gender_notes: Adna is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A beautiful and elegant name meaning 'adornment', derived from the Arabic root 'dana' which means 'to adorn'. This name carries the essence of simplicity, softness and beauty. The name Adna carries the meaning “Adornment” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Adna usually hope their child will grow to embody adornment and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the inner adornment of the soul and the outer adornment of the body.
data.etymology: Adna belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Adornment.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adna total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
